summary: Twelve preseason games were played, two of them going to overtime: Boston beat Philadelphia 125-120 and Milwaukee beat Indiana 128-127. New Orleans beat Washington 107-106 in the other one-point game. San Antonio's 126-97 win over Sacramento was the largest margin, and the Spurs led by as many as 37 points.

games.headline: Hawks lead by up to 29 in 135-111 win at Dallas
games.story: Atlanta led 39-34 after the first quarter and 73-54 at halftime, and the Mavericks never led by more than 1 point, at 24-23 in the first. The Hawks went ahead for good after a 28-28 tie with 2:56 left in the first quarter, and their lead reached 29 at 118-89 in the fourth. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 25 for Atlanta and Jalen Johnson had 20 points and 14 rebounds. Cooper Flagg led Dallas with 26 points and 12 rebounds.

games.headline: Celtics beat 76ers 125-120 in overtime
games.story: Philadelphia led by as many as 14, at 86-72 in the third quarter, and led 94-84 going into the fourth. Boston outscored the 76ers 31-21 in the fourth to tie it at 115-115, and the game was tied 10 times with 16 lead changes. After a 117-117 tie with 3:21 left in overtime, the Celtics went ahead for good and won the extra period 10-5. Hugo González scored 21 for Boston, while Joel Embiid had 27 points and 8 rebounds and Tyrese Maxey scored 22 for Philadelphia.

games.headline: Warriors pull away from Trail Blazers 128-118
games.story: Golden State led 35-26 after the first quarter and 67-58 at halftime, then outscored Portland 38-33 in the third. The Warriors went ahead for good after a 17-17 tie with 5:03 left in the first quarter, and their lead reached 25 at 97-72 in the third. Stephen Curry scored 20, and Yaxel Lendeborg and Brandin Podziemski each had 17. Damian Lillard led Portland with 23 points and Ja Morant added 19.

games.headline: Magic outscore Heat 136-115, lead by up to 23
games.story: Miami led 36-34 after the first quarter, but Orlando led 70-65 at halftime and 108-95 after three. The score was tied 80-80 with 7:49 left in the third quarter, and the Magic led the rest of the way, building a 23-point lead at 136-113 late in the fourth. Paolo Banchero had 24 points and 7 rebounds and Desmond Bane scored 23. Ryan Conwell led Miami with 21 points and 7 assists. Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo did not play for the Heat.

games.headline: Pistons hold off Raptors' late rally, 129-125
games.story: Detroit led 59-52 at halftime and 93-80 after three, and its lead reached 14 at 94-80 early in the fourth quarter. Toronto outscored the Pistons 45-36 in the fourth and tied it at 104-104 with 5:53 left, but Detroit went ahead for good soon after. The game was tied 13 times with 18 lead changes. Malachi Smith scored 24 and Trayce Jackson-Davis had 23 for Toronto, while Cade Cunningham had 18 points and 7 assists for Detroit. Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard did not play for the Raptors.

games.headline: Bucks edge Pacers 128-127 in overtime
games.story: Indiana led by as many as 19, at 66-47 in the second quarter, and led 71-56 at halftime. Milwaukee came back to tie it at 117-117 and send the game to overtime, where the Pacers were ahead 125-124 with 1:13 left before the Bucks went in front for good. Milwaukee won the extra period 11-10. Tyler Herro scored 25 for the Bucks, and Pascal Siakam had 24 points for Indiana, which was tied 5 times and saw 13 lead changes in the game.

games.headline: Bulls beat Timberwolves 133-116 behind a 21-point lead
games.story: Chicago led 33-28 after the first quarter and 67-60 at halftime. The score was tied at 54-54 with 3:44 left in the second quarter, and the Bulls led from there, building a 21-point lead at 126-105 in the fourth. Isaiah Evans scored 21 for Minnesota, and Jaylen Clark and Drew Timme each had 18. Caleb Wilson led Chicago with 16 points and 7 rebounds. Anthony Edwards and Rudy Gobert did not play for the Timberwolves.

games.headline: Grizzlies pull away from Hornets for 117-98 win
games.story: Memphis led 23-20 after the first quarter and 50-38 at halftime. The game was tied 33-33 with 4:07 left in the second quarter, and the Grizzlies led the rest of the way, stretching it to 30 points at 115-85 in the fourth. Cameron Boozer had 19 points and 7 rebounds for Memphis and Ty Jerome scored 17. Hannes Steinbach had 19 points and 10 rebounds for Charlotte, which led by as many as 11, at 17-6 in the first quarter.

games.headline: Pelicans survive Wizards' rally, win 107-106
games.story: New Orleans led 23-17 after the first quarter and 56-51 at halftime, and went ahead for good after a 10-10 tie with 5:28 left in the first. The lead reached 14 at 92-78 in the fourth quarter, but Washington outscored the Pelicans 36-26 in the period and got within 1 point at the final buzzer. Saddiq Bey scored 19 for New Orleans and Jeremiah Fears had 14 points and 5 assists. Anthony Davis had 14 points and 11 rebounds for Washington, and Kyshawn George also scored 14.

games.headline: Spurs rout Kings 126-97, lead by up to 37
games.story: San Antonio scored 42 points in the first quarter and led 42-18 at its end, then 71-37 at halftime. The Spurs led the rest of the way after a 2-2 tie with 11:07 left in the first, and their lead reached 37 at 71-34 in the second quarter. Dylan Harper scored 19 and De'Aaron Fox had 16 points and 6 rebounds. Zach LaVine led Sacramento with 20 points, and Domantas Sabonis had 14 points and 10 rebounds.

games.headline: Jazz rally past Suns 119-116 with a 29-21 fourth
games.story: Phoenix led 65-59 at halftime and 95-90 after three, with its lead reaching 13 at 77-64 in the third quarter. Utah outscored the Suns 29-21 in the fourth, and after a 109-109 tie with 3:03 left the Jazz went ahead for good. The game was tied 7 times with 8 lead changes. Lauri Markkanen scored 19 and Jaren Jackson Jr. had 17 for Utah. Dillon Brooks and Jalen Green each scored 18 for Phoenix, and Devin Booker had 16 points and 6 assists.

games.headline: Nuggets beat Lakers 121-106 behind fast start
games.story: Denver scored 36 points in the first quarter and led by 17 at 34-17 with 1:18 left in it. The Nuggets led the rest of the way after a 4-4 tie with 9:47 left in the first, and led 62-55 at halftime and 88-83 after three. Jamal Murray had 21 points and 6 assists, and Nikola Jokić had 17 points, 6 rebounds and 8 assists. Austin Reaves led Los Angeles with 19 points, and Luka Dončić scored 15.
